description: The direction of a metric's movement as a trend surface paints it — the FACT (did the number go up), never the verdict (was that good). TmStatCard's PositiveIsGood decides only the tone, so a falling churn rate is Down and good news at the same time.

members.name: Auto
members.description: Derive the direction from the sign of the delta (a positive delta is Up, a negative one Down, zero Flat). The default; when no delta is supplied either, no trend marker renders.

members.name: Up
members.description: The metric rose, whatever the delta says — for a metric whose delta is unknown but whose direction is not.

members.name: Flat
members.description: The metric did not move. Painted as the neutral tone.
